question: Should padding-only static evidence for GitHub-backed skills remain reviewer-only ClawScan context, or may it also set public suspicious visibility fields while installability stays clean?
rationale: This choice changes a security-sensitive scan boundary and public discovery semantics; source inspection cannot decide whether maintainers want that policy change.

options.title: Keep Reviewer-Only Context
options.body: Route the detector through the durable GitHub ClawScan request flow and retain padding findings without setting flagged.suspicious/isSuspicious for padding-only clean-installability results.

options.title: Approve Public Suspicious Visibility
options.body: Allow padding-only findings to hide skills from public browse/search, but require explicit spec language, focused tests, and live proof of installability and discovery behavior.

options.title: Pause The Branch
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it until a maintainer-sponsored security design settles the scan-boundary and visibility policy.

recommendation.title: Keep Reviewer-Only Context
recommendation.body: Route the detector through the durable GitHub ClawScan request flow and retain padding findings without setting flagged.suspicious/isSuspicious for padding-only clean-installability results.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the recent GitHub-backed ClawScan flow history and spec evidence most directly affected by this choice.
